terra.problem: The quotation is from Deuteronomy 28:32, not Deuteronomy 32:32.
The verse says they will worship other gods, but does not say they will worship them instead of the LORD.
The last sentence says no one else the LORD sends is in the verse, but the verse explicitly says He will send their enemies.
The verse says Israel will not understand the nation's language. Saying they will not understand a word goes beyond that.
